skill.displayName: Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper

llm.summary: This skill provides ordinary workflow guidance, although broad activation keywords may cause it to appear during unrelated tasks.

dimensions.detail: The workflow follows the user's requested outcome and favors modest local resources. No credential access, broad private-data collection, or external data transmission is instructed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown documentation and interface configuration, with no executable scripts, dependency installation, or install hooks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Common-word triggers and enabled implicit invocation support the advisory scanner's routing concern. The resulting instructions remain ordinary task assistance, making this a reliability issue rather than a material security concern.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No elevated privileges, persistent memory changes, background workers, scheduled tasks, or autonomous bulk modifications are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The instructions provide user-directed planning, checklists, implementation assistance, and validation consistent with the stated workflow-helper purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this for planning and checklists; it does not include an automated security scanner. Prefer explicit invocation or disable implicit invocation to avoid selection on common words. Its demand score is not a security certification.
